title: catchr
description: Instant no-signup webhook & HTTP-request inspector for testing webhooks and agent tool-callbacks.
summary: Instant no-signup webhook & HTTP-request inspector for testing webhooks and agent tool-callbacks.
offersHint: Instant no-signup webhook & HTTP-request inspector for testing webhooks and agent tool-callbacks. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://catchr.perch-app.workers.dev/mcp

toolsPreview.name: create_bin
toolsPreview.description: Create a new no-signup capture bin. Returns a live URL you can point any webhook, callback, or agent tool-callback at, plus a token to read what it captured. No account needed.

toolsPreview.name: get_requests
toolsPreview.description: Read the HTTP requests captured by a bin (method, path, query, headers, body), newest first. Set wait to block until a request arrives — ideal for 'trigger then assert' with no polling loop.

toolsPreview.name: set_response
toolsPreview.description: Configure the HTTP response a bin returns to whatever hits its URL — set a status code, content-type and body. Use it to test how your webhook sender / agent handles a 500, a specific JSON reply, etc. Omit or reset to return the default 200. Requires the bin token.

toolsPreview.name: clear_bin
toolsPreview.description: Delete all captured requests from a bin (the bin stays usable). Requires the bin token.
